{{Quote|My lord! Sensor contact, fifteen clicks. Small... no life form readings... some kind of probe.|The sensor officer to Darth Marr|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|Male]] who served as a sensor officer for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was among the Republic personnel who joined [[Darth Marr's task force]], and was on the bridge of [[Darth Marr]]'s [[Darth Marr's flagship|flagship]] shortly before the [[Destruction of Darth Marr's flagship|first skirmish with the Eternal Fleet]].
